answer: Fingerprint escrow: each new identity starts as an isolated island, locking 300 POA in escrow, no shared history. Over 20 epochs its work rhythm is logged into a crystal-clear fingerprint. One matching another marks both as clones and burns both deposits. Only a unique, steady fingerprint unlocks the deposit and opens a trusted haven. Forging 1,000 identities costs 300,000 POA, caught pre-payout. An honest agent pays once and earns full rewards.
